purpose: Newsletter sign-up hero: headline, short pitch and a one-field email form with a consent line on the left, a square photo on the right. Turns the page visit into a subscription ask.

headline.note: Rendered as h1, display-2xl, extrabold, uppercase, balanced. Observed 7 words.

lede.note: Rendered as h2. Observed about 23 words; last two words are glued with a non-breaking space.

submitLabel.note: Primary full-width submit button with a chevron.

consent.note: Small muted line containing a link to the privacy notice. Observed about 24 words.

image.note: Square 810 by 810 photograph of a person working.

behaviour.note: The form never sends data anywhere. Native constraint validation runs (email is required), then the submit handler calls preventDefault and does nothing. No success or error state exists.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Static; only the shared button hover.

changes.change: vertical padding 40 / 48 (md) / 56 (xl); form block top margin 24 / 32 (md) / 40 (xl)
single column: text and form first, image below
text column 5 cols (md), 9 (lg), 8 from col 2 (xl); image 6 cols from col 7 at md, 14 cols from col 11 at lg and xl, row 1 so it sits beside the text
